categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: 01 - Free Fallin' to the Feast Layer!
locations.description:
**Location:** Only appears here if you revisit the Radiance Layer - specifically, the boss arena on SL1204 - and grab a key to destroy the Void totem in the room above.

Jump down the hole that appears to find yourself back in the Feast layer with the bananas in front of you.

locations.title: 02 - A Slime-Slathered Treat
locations.description: **Location:** Covered in muck against the wall behind the Warp Gong. Throw a salt chunk at it to access the gem.

locations.title: 03 - Wrecked by Freestyle Bananzas
locations.description: **Location:** [Freestyle Bananzas: City Smash](#loc=482909) - Destroy the building in under one minute.

locations.title: 04 - Fast-Paced Freestyle Bananzas
locations.description:
**Location:** [Freestyle Bananzas: City Smash](#loc=482909) - Destroy the building with at least 20 seconds remaining on the clock.

_Tip: Elephant Banaza can begin the destruction while standing behind the starting line!_

locations.title: 05 - Lost and Found under the Building
locations.description: **Location:** [Freestyle Bananzas: City Smash](#loc=482909) - Underneath the blue balloon lift. Smack the balloon to raise the platform, then slip underneath.

locations.title: 06 - Battle: Bouncy Beatings
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Feast Layer Battle Challenge 1](#loc=482913)

locations.title: 07 - Snacking from the Stockroom
locations.description: **Location:** Underground, in the basement of the [Chip Exchange](#loc=482916). Go down the right-most ramp, then use a chunk of salt to remove the muck and access the gem.

locations.title: 08 - A Banana among Friends
locations.description: **Location:** In a pile of gold, on a platform on the other side of the muck wall.

locations.title: 09 - Battle: Wallopoid Warfare
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Feast Layer Battle Challenge 2](#loc=482921)

locations.title: 10 - A Soda-Infused Banana
locations.description: **Location:** At the bottom of the soda tower.

locations.title: 11 - The Feast Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone after feeding it 500 Gold.

locations.title: 12 - The Hungry Feast Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone after feeding it 2,500 Gold.

locations.title: 13 - The Sated Feast Growtone
locations.description: **Location:** Appears on the Growtone after feeding it 5,000 Gold.

locations.title: 14 - A Secret Salty Snack
locations.description: **Location:** [Steady Flow of Salt](#loc=482927) - In a secret room, behind the first salt wall near the top.

locations.title: 15 - Slinging the Salt
locations.description: **Location:** [Steady Flow of Salt](#loc=482927) - On the top of the first pillar with a salt wall.

locations.title: 16 - Melting the Muck
locations.description: **Location:** [Steady Flow of Salt](#loc=482927) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 17 - Steamed-and-Salted Banana
locations.description: **Location:** In a salt pile, behind the wall.

locations.title: 18 - At a Grate Height
locations.description: **Location:** On the top of the Grater-go-Round. Can be reached with Snake Bananza.

locations.title: 19 - 'Round the Grater-Go-Round!
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the Grater-go-Round, on the bottom floor.

locations.title: 20 - Through the Mauling Walls
locations.description: **Location:** [Trap-Filled Towers](#loc=482936) - Beyond the first tower and cheese path.

locations.title: 21 - A Wall All Alone
locations.description:
**Location:** [Trap-Filled Towers](#loc=482936) - After grabbing [20 - Through the Mauling Walls](#loc=482937):
1. Continue the course until you reach 3 Sand Wallopoids. Punch through the center to reveal a hole.
2. Jump down the hole and climb to the other side to reveal a lonely Wallopoid.
3. Break through it to access the gem.

locations.title: 22 - Falling Mauling Walls
locations.description: **Location:** [Trap-Filled Towers](#loc=482936) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 23 - Up High in a Sky Container
locations.description: **Location:** Near the top of Kingly Swings, behind a muck wall.

locations.title: 24 - Swingin' through Kingly Swings!
locations.description: **Location:** At the very top of Kingly Swings, next to the Burger Switch.

locations.title: 25 - Soda-Spout Clean Out
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the soda-filled tub. Empty it by throwing some salt at the muck-clogged spout behind the tub.

locations.title: 26 - Battle: Muck on Parade
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Feast Layer Battle Challenge 3](#loc=482944)

locations.title: 27 - Shifty Smash: Over the Oil Lake
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash](#loc=482946).

locations.title: 28 - Feast Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given by the Smashintone after smashing through 30,000 cubic meters of salt in the layer.

locations.title: 29 - Feast Quiz Master
locations.description:
**Location:** Given by the Quiztone after completing the quiz. Use the following answers:
- Giant speaker
- Lightning equipment
- Forest of nuggets

locations.title: 30 - Feast Fragmentone Recovery
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for reuniting the first Fragment with its body. The closest one can be found [here](#loc=491788).

locations.title: 31 - Feast Fragmentone Restoration
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for reuniting [Fragment 1](#loc=491788) and [Fragment 2 & 3](#loc=491789) with their body.

locations.title: 32 - Banana by a Greasy River
locations.description: **Location:** Behind a muck wall along the oil river. Throw salt from any salt platform to access.

locations.title: 33 - Center of the Oil Stream
locations.description: **Location:** In a room in the center of the oil river. To access, first break the Void Machine to reveal the Muckoid, then use the nearby salt to defeat it and access the gem.

locations.title: 34 - Battle: Mine-Cart Muck
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Feast Layer Battle Challenge 4](#loc=482955)

locations.title: 35 - Fryin' at Ferocious Fryhouse!
locations.description: **Location:** In the center of the fryhouse, after defeating the Mad Mixer.

locations.title: 36 - Feast Hide-and-Seek
locations.description: **Location:** In the hidden tomb; dig down beside the ladder. Given upon finding and revealing [Hiddentone 1](#loc=491695), [Hiddentone 2](#loc=491694), [Hiddentone 3](#loc=491692) and [Hiddentone 4](#loc=491693).

locations.title: 46 - Shifty Smash: Huge Monument
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for beating the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=491672).

locations.title: 56 - Crowning the Monarch
locations.description: **Location:** On top of the giant lion statue's mane.

locations.title: 41 - Fries on the Side
locations.description: **Location:** Underground, behind a wall of muck in the corner of the refinery's 'moving salt platforms' room.

locations.title: 43 - Floating on a Royal Oil Cruise!
locations.description: **Location:** Underground, next to the Burger Switch in the corner of the refinery.

locations.title: 47 - Danger Doubling Back
locations.description: **Location:** Underground, in the room behind a Wallopoid. Can only be collected after destroying a Void Tank.

locations.title: 40 - Unmucking the Works
locations.description: **Location:** At the bottom of the soda tank. Can only be collected by destroying the Muck blocking a pipe, found underground a short distance to the north.

locations.title: 49 - Triple-Gated Banana
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a cage on an island reached by riding the minecart from [Grater-Go-Round](#loc=491652) to Mane Gate Market and throwing a rock at the arrow sign.

Once you're on the island, climb onto the platform and destroy two muck walls to reach the banana.

_Tip: Use the Snake Bananza's double jump!_

locations.title: 37 - Roarcoaster Rest Stop
locations.description: **Location:** [Branching-Track Roarcoster](#loc=482960) - In front of the minecart's first stopping point.

locations.title: 39 - A Roaring Finish
locations.description: **Location:** [Branching-Track Roarcoster](#loc=482960) - At the end of the course.

locations.title: 38 - Behind a Roaring Waterfall
locations.description: **Location:** [Branching-Track Roarcoster](#loc=482960) - Halfway through the course, one track splits off behind a waterfall. Throw a rock at the arrow sign behind some flowing water to find the banana there.

locations.title: 48 - Battle: Labyrinth Lurkers
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing [Feast Layer Battle Challenge 5](#loc=491740).

locations.title: 45 - Eating the Lion's Share
locations.description: **Location:** In the mouth of the lion statue next to the minecart track.

locations.title: 42 - The Duct Inspector's Reward
locations.description: **Location:** Underground, on top of a vent inside the refinery's 'moving salt platforms' room. To reach it, climb up a pipe next to the [Royal Oil Cruise](#loc=491682) checkpoint and use Ostrich Bananza to fly over to the duct next to a large blue vent hood.

locations.title: 44 - The Salt's Last Stop
locations.description: **Location:** Underground. After grabbing [43 - Floating on a Royal Oil Cruise!](#loc=491685), climb back down the ladder and go around the platform for another quick ride on a moving salt platform to reach it.

locations.title: 51 - Up through the Layer of Muck
locations.description: **Location:** In the middle of a circle of muck in the air next to [Umbrella-Straw Station](#loc=491783). Use Snake Bananza to reach it.

locations.title: 50 - Shifty Smash: Out of the Box

locations.title: 63 - The Muck's Private Stash

locations.title: 61 - Cranky's Feast Rant

locations.title: 64 - Resist the Tide of Walls
locations.description: **Location:** [Waves of Walls](#loc=491818) - Behind the first series of moving walls.

locations.title: 65 - Bouncing Tall off a Wall
locations.description: **Location:** [Waves of Walls](#loc=491818) - When you reach the end of the second series of moving walls, stand on the spot where they spawn and charge a jump. When a tall wall spawns, release the jump to grip the ceiling where the banana awaits.

locations.title: 66 - Strike Back against the Walls

locations.title: 67 - Melt through the Metal Bridge

locations.title: 68 - Stuck in the Muck

locations.title: 69 - Decked Out in Matching Clothes
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for speaking to the Glamtone while wearing Burn-Proof Britches and the Yellow Tempest Coat.

locations.title: Purple Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces shock damage from electrified iron or muck by 10 percent.

**Cost:** 1 Old Tire

locations.title: Shock-Proof Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces shock damage from electrified iron or muck by 10 percent.

**Cost:** 5 Old Tires

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 30 percent: 10 Old Tires
- Increase to 40 percent: 3 Cathode-Ray Tubes

locations.title: Yum-Yum Tie
locations.description:
**Effect:** Pressing Y to eat any foods or food-based terrain (not just fruit) will recover your health.

**Cost:** 1 Cathode-Ray Tube

**Upgrades:**
- Double the effectiveness: 3 Cathode-Ray Tubes
- Triple the effectiveness: 1 Robot

locations.title: Prime Feast Apparel
locations.description:
**Effect:** During Bananzas, your health will gradually recover.

**Cost:** 5 Old Tires

**Upgrades:**
- 25 percent faster: 10 Old Tires
- 50 percent faster: 3 Cathode-Ray Tubes
